name: AO Smith HSE-SHS-015 15L Storage Water Heater
specs: Blue Diamond glass-lined inner tank
High-grade glass-coated heating element
Hard water aur high TDS borewell paani ke liye best
verdict: High-TDS borewell paani me scaling rokne ke liye iska Blue Diamond coating market me sabse durable mana jata hai.

name: Racold Eterno Pro SP 15L Vertical Water Heater
specs: Titanium Plus technology with enamel coating
Smart Bath Logic technology (energy saving)
Multi-storey apartments ke high pressure ke liye sturdy
verdict: High-rise apartments jahan pressure pump ka continuous load hota hai, wahan iska titanium tank welding leak proof safety deta hai.

name: Havells Monza Pro 15L Storage Geyser
specs: Feroglas coated inner tank with single weld design
Heavy-duty Incoloy 800 glass-coated heating element
Whirlflow technology for faster heating & energy saving
verdict: Nationwide reliable service network aur durable build quality ke sath aam family ke liye ek safe aur budget-friendly model.

name: V-Guard Divino DG 15L Storage Water Heater
specs: Advanced vitreous enamel tank coating
Extra thick magnesium anode rod for tank protection
Digital temperature display & compact vertical design
verdict: Digital display, thick PUF insulation aur lowest running electricity bill ke liye value-for-money choice.

name: Schneider Acti9 40A 30mA Double Pole RCCB
specs: Instant tripping (<30ms) on earth leakage current
Double pole isolation (cuts both Phase & Neutral)
High endurance mechanical trip indicator window
verdict: MCB sirf taar bachata hai, insani jaan sirf 30mA RCCB hi bachata hai. Geyser aur bathroom circuits ke liye anivarya device.

name: Schneider Acti9 40A DP C-Curve 10kA MCB
specs: 10kA fault level short-circuit protection
C-Curve profile: Inductive home load aur AC surges ke liye safe
Double Pole (DP) dual isolation: Phase aur Neutral dono ek sath cut
verdict: Schneider ka Acti9 mechanism contact welding ke khilaf market me sabse reliable hai. Ghar ke main distribution board incomer ke liye top-grade breaker.

name: JPT Non-Contact Smart Voltage Tester Pen
specs: Non-contact live & neutral wire detection
Audible buzzer & visual dual LED alarm indicator
Built-in bright LED torch for dark distribution boards
verdict: Bina taar ka insulation chhile ya kate live phase aur neutral detect karne ke liye har electrician aur ghar ke liye sabse safe tool.
